ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: After ignoring the curved arrows in the figure, a benzene ring connected to a nitrogen atom bearing H can be seen, forming an N-H anilino group; this nitrogen is then connected to one end of the conjugated chain on the right. The conjugated chain contains a protonated carbonyl-like fragment C=[OH+], with H and a positive charge marked on the oxygen; the chain also has a C=C double bond, and R¹, R² substituents are marked on the corresponding carbons, which can be represented by wildcard *. Then reasoning: Write the SMILES from an R placeholder * connected to the protonated carbonyl carbon as *C(=[OH+]), continue along the shown alkene configuration as /C=C(/*), and finally attach the N-H anilino group connected to the benzene ring, Nc1ccccc1. Therefore the SMILES is *C(=[OH+])/C=C(/*)Nc1ccccc1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a chemical structure with arrows ignored: a conjugated chain contains a protonated carbonyl-like C=[OH+] at one end, an alkene C=C, an R substituent on the carbonyl carbon, an R2 substituent on the alkene carbon, and an N-H anilino group attached to the other alkene carbon, with the nitrogen bonded to a phenyl ring. Convert this connectivity into SMILES by starting at the R placeholder as *, writing the protonated carbonyl carbon as C(=[OH+]), continuing across the alkene with the depicted stereochemical slash as /C=C(/*), then appending the anilino substituent as Nc1ccccc1. The resulting expression is *C(=[OH+])/C=C(/*)Nc1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个忽略箭头的过渡态结构，左侧为芳环，连接到一个带正电的氧/质子化羰基样片段 OH+；右侧沿共轭链连接一个烯烃片段，烯烃上方有 R²，右下连有 N-H 的苯胺基并接一个苯环，另一侧标有 R¹。再推理：按主链从左端的 * 开始，写作 *C(=[OH+])，沿图示双键立体关系写成 /C=C(/*)，最后接上苯胺基 Nc1ccccc1，因此 SMILES 为 *C(=[OH+])/C=C(/*)Nc1ccccc1。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中是一个忽略箭头的过渡态结构，左侧为芳环，连接到一个带正电的氧/质子化羰基样片段 OH+；右侧沿共轭链连接一个烯烃片段，烯烃上方有 R²，右下连有 N-H 的苯胺基并接一个苯环，另一侧标有 R¹。再推理：按主链从左端的 * 开始，写作 *C(=[OH+])，沿图示双键立体关系写成 /C=C(/*)，最后接上苯胺基 Nc1ccccc1，因此 SMILES 为 *C(=[OH+])/C=C(/*)Nc1ccccc1。
method.CoT_qualify_0: Revise the image description to avoid saying the left aromatic ring is connected to the protonated carbonyl/OH+ fragment. The phenyl ring should be described as bonded to the N-H anilino nitrogen, while the protonated carbonyl-like C=[OH+] belongs to the conjugated chain and bears the R placeholder. Then proceed with the same SMILES construction: *C(=[OH+])/C=C(/*)Nc1ccccc1.
method.CoT_after_polish_1: 先描述图像：图中忽略弯箭头后，可见一个苯环与带 H 的氮原子相连，形成 N-H 苯胺基；该氮再连接到右侧共轭链的一端。共轭链中包含一个质子化羰基样片段 C=[OH+]，氧上标有 H 和正电荷；链上还有 C=C 双键，并在相应碳上标有 R¹、R² 取代基，这些可用通配符 * 表示。再推理：按 SMILES 从一个 R 占位符 * 连接到质子化羰基碳写作 *C(=[OH+])，沿图示烯键构型继续写为 /C=C(/*)，最后接上与苯环相连的 N-H 苯胺基 Nc1ccccc1。因此 SMILES 为 *C(=[OH+])/C=C(/*)Nc1ccccc1。
method.CoT_qualify_1: Trace passes. planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription is the natural single route for this image-grounded task; it is distinct because it relies on reading the displayed connectivity and then encoding it, rather than comparing answer choices or using reaction-mechanism inference.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the chemical drawing while ignoring all curved arrows: identify the protonated oxygen as [OH+] double-bonded to a carbon, that carbon bearing an R substituent placeholder; follow the conjugated C=C segment to the carbon bearing an R2 placeholder and bonded to an anilino nitrogen; identify the nitrogen as N-H attached to a phenyl ring; replace each R group with wildcard * and preserve the drawn alkene geometry with slash notation.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and explicitly says to ignore the arrows; no other textual chemical data are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply SMILES conventions for skeletal structures: unlabeled vertices are carbons, R groups can be represented as wildcard atoms *, protonated carbonyl oxygen is written [OH+] in C(=[OH+]), benzene attached to nitrogen is Nc1ccccc1, and directional / notation can encode the depicted alkene stereochemistry.
